page.description: DietPi images for x86_64: the two VM installer ISOs, their sizes and publisher SHA-256 files.
page.intro: A minimal Debian-based system built for small boards and VMs. DietPi publishes per-board images; for x86_64 the published installers are the two VM ISOs pinned here.
pros: Per-image SHA-256 and signature files published.
A menu-driven dietpi-config for services and updates.
The x86_64 VM images are the only PC-shaped media the project ships.
cons: No general-purpose x86_64 desktop ISO; these are VM installers.
The version is the build date (2026-10-22).
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so the page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for DietPi; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: One image per firmware type: the UEFI and the BIOS VM installer ISO, written with dd or any image writer. Writing erases the stick; these images are intended for virtual machines. The version is the build date (2026-10-22).
